senses.gloss: Nīla^2, king of Māhishmatī. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2697 (bhūmipaḥ, among the incarnations from the Krodhavaśa gaṇa).--§ 232 (Svayaṃvarap.): I, 186, 6990 (present at the svayaṃvara of Draupadī).--§ 282 (Sahadeva): II, 31, 1124 (on his digvijaya Sahadeva fought with N., who was assisted by Agni).--§ 282b (Māhishmatī): II, 31 [1131 (ºrājñoduhitā)], 1133 (Agni married the daughter of N.).--§ 284 (Sahadeva): II, 31, 1160 (ºsya kule), 1162 (paid tribute to Sahadeva).--§ 515 (Karṇadigvijaya): III, 254, 15250 (mahīpatiṃ, vanquished by Karṇa on his digvijaya).--§ 554 (Sainyodyogap.): V, 4, 79.--§ 555 (do.): V, 19, 592 (Māhishmatīvāsī Nºo Nīlāyudhaiḥ saha, came with troops to Duryodhana).--§ 572 (Rathātirathasaṅkhyānap.): V, 166, 5751 (Māhishmatīvāsī nīlavarmā, among the rathas in Duryodhana's army).--§ 580 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 56, 2414 (Nīlāyudhaiḥ saha, in the army of Yudhishṭhira), 2415.--§ 585 (do.): VI, 93, 4153 (Anūpādhipatiḥ, followed Ghaṭotkaca); 94, 4210 (Anūpādhipatiḥ), 4213, 4215, 4216, 4217 (fought with Aśvatthāman, was defeated and swooned).--§ 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 23, 1012 (proceeded against Droṇa, description of his horses, etc); 25, 1109 (fought with the sons of Dhṛtarāshṭra); 31, 1362, 1364, 1365, 1367, 1370 (slain by Aśvatthāman). --§ 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 6, 166 (Anūpavāsī, had been slain by Aśvatthāman).--§ 621 (Rājadh.): XII, 4, 113 (present at the svayaṃvara of the daughter of the Kaliṅga king Citrāṅgada). Cf. Nīlarājan.

Nīla^3, a mountain. § 459 (Mārkaṇḍeyas.): III, 188, 12918 (seen by Mārkaṇḍeya in the stomach of Nārāyaṇa).--§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 6, 198 (vaidūryaparvataḥ, among the varshaparvatas of Jambūdvīpa), 202 (dakshiṇena tu Nºsya Nishadhasyottareṇa, there lies Mālyavat) (), 232 (north of Nīla lies the [varsha]
Śveta), 247 (the abode of Brahmarshis). --§ 574g (Uttara-Kuru, pl.): VI, 7, 254 (dakshiṇena tu Nºsya Meror pārśve tathottare, there the Uttara Kurus live). --§ 574i (Jambū): VI, 7, 272 (dakshiṇena tu Nºsya Nishadhasyottareṇa tu, there the Jambū tree is situated).-§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 8, 290 (dakshineṇa tu Nīlasya Nishadhasyottarena tu, there lies the varsha Hiraṇmaya).-§ 775 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 166, 7658 (enumeration).-§ 782g (Guruśishyasaṃv.): XIV, 43, 1174 (enumeration). --§ 785 (Anugītāp.): XIV, 76, 2201 (? śailaṃ Nºm ivāmbudaḥ). Cf. Nīlaparvata.

Nīla^4, a monkey. § 535 (Setubandhana): III, 283, 16287 (in the army of the monkeys).--§ 539 (Kumbhakarṇādivadha): III, 287, 16435 (fought with the Rākshasa Pramāthin).--§ 541 (Indrajidvadha): III, 289, 16468, (), 16477.--§ 542 (Rāvaṇavadha): III, 290, 16500.
Nīla^5, a Pāṇḍava warrior. § 572 (Rathātirathasaṅkhyānap.): V, 171, 5907 (among the rathas in the armv of Yudhishṭhira). Cf. Nīla^2.
Nīlā, a river. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 339 (only B., C. has Nālāṃ).
Nīlaparvata, a mountain. § 733f (Gaṅgādvāra): XIII, 25, 1700. Cf. Nīla^2.
Nīlavāsas (“dressed in dark clothes”) = Balarāma: I, 7950; IX, 2137, 3126.
Nīlāyudha, pl. (ºāḥ), a people (= the followers of Nīla?). § 555 (Sainyodyogap.): V, 19, 592 (C. has by error Līº).-§ 580 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 56, 2414.
Nīlī, wife of Ajamīḍha. § 152 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 94, 3722 (second wife of Ajamīḍha and mother of Dushyanta and Parameshṭhin).
